added.title: Access to Outsourced Facilities/Premises/Data
added.summary: Investment Advisers shall have access to facilities, premises, and data used in outsourced activities.
added.trigger: Outsourcing arrangements
added.required_action: Access to facilities, premises, and data
added.evidence: Documentation of access rights
added.verbatim_text: The facilities / premises / data that are involved in carrying out the outsourced activity by the service provider shall be deemed to be those of the registered intermediary. The intermediary itself and Regulator or the persons authorized by it shall have the right to access the same at any point of time.

added.title: Include Additional Terms and Conditions
added.summary: Investment Advisers can include additional terms and conditions in the agreement without diluting existing regulations.
added.trigger: When amending agreements with clients.
added.required_action: Include additional terms and conditions as per IA Regulations and SEBI circulars.
added.evidence: Copies of updated client agreements.
added.verbatim_text: IA can also include additional terms and conditions in the agreement without diluting the provisions of the IA Regulations and amendments thereto as well as circulars issued thereunder.

added.title: Retention of Advertisement Copies
added.summary: IA shall retain copies of advertisements for a period of five years.
added.trigger: Issuance of advertisement
added.required_action: Retain copies for 5 years
added.evidence: Retention records and storage logs
added.verbatim_text: Copy of the advertisement shall be retained by IA for a period of five years in terms of Regulation 19(2) of the IA Regulations.

added.title: Comply with Suspension Orders During Period of Suspension
added.summary: Investment Advisers must not issue any advertisement during the period of suspension by SEBI or a recognized supervisory body.
added.trigger: Suspension order from SEBI or a recognized supervisory body
added.required_action: Do not issue any advertisements either singly or jointly with other investment advisers during the period of suspension.
added.evidence: Documentation showing compliance with the suspension order.
added.verbatim_text: "In the event of suspension of any IA by SEBI and/or by SEBI recognized supervisory body, the IA so suspended shall not issue any advertisement either singly or jointly with any other IA, during the period of susp"

added.title: Investment Adviser Declaration in Agreement
added.summary: Make specific declarations regarding services, fees, and risk management.
added.trigger: Before providing any investment advisory services
added.required_action: Make the specified declarations in the agreement.
added.evidence: Signed agreement showing the required declarations.
added.verbatim_text: b) Declaration from the Investment Adviser that:

added.title: Submit Adverse Findings of Audit to IAASB/SEBI
added.summary: IAs must submit adverse findings, if any, along with the action taken thereof within one month from the date of the audit report.
added.trigger: End of each financial year
added.required_action: Submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year.
added.evidence: Audit reports and documentation of actions taken.
added.verbatim_text: An IA shall - (ii) submit adverse findings of audit, if any, along with action taken thereof duly approved by the individual IA or management of non-individual IA to IAASB/SEBI within a period of one month from the date of the audit report but not later than October 31st of each year for the previous financial year;

added.title: Publish Adverse Findings and Action Taken Thereof on Website
added.summary: IAs must publish any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, on their website.
added.trigger: End of each financial year
added.required_action: Publish any adverse findings of the audit, along with the action taken thereof, on the IA’s website.
added.evidence: Website content showing published reports and findings.
added.verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

added.title: Publish Annual Compliance Audit Report and Adverse Findings on Website
added.summary: IAs must publish their annual compliance audit report, including any adverse findings and the action taken thereof, on their website.
added.trigger: End of each financial year
added.required_action: Publish the status of the compliance audit report and any adverse findings along with the action taken thereof on the IA’s website. Provide the compliance audit report to clients.
added.evidence: Website content showing published reports and findings.
added.verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

added.title: Publish Annual Compliance Audit Report on Website
added.summary: IAs must publish their annual compliance audit report on their website.
added.trigger: End of each financial year
added.required_action: Publish the status of the compliance audit report on the IA’s website.
added.evidence: Website content showing published reports.
added.verbatim_text: IA shall publish the status of the compliance audit report on its website and shall also publish the adverse findings of audit, if any, along with the action taken thereof on their website. IA shall provide the compliance audit report to its clients.

added.title: Transparency in Brand Name Usage
added.summary: IA must prominently display certain information on various platforms and documents.
added.trigger: Usage of brand name, trade name, or logo
added.required_action: Display required information prominently
added.evidence: Screenshots of displayed information, internal policies
added.verbatim_text: The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number and its complete address with telephone numbers shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements. The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number, its complete address with telephone numbers, the name of the compliance officer, his telephone number and e-mail address, the name, telephone number and e-mail address of the grievance officer or the grievance redressal cell shall be displayed prominently in statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client. Disclaimer that “Registration granted by SEBI, enlistment with BSE and certification from NISM in no way guarantee performance of the IA or provide any assurance of returns to investors” shall be mentioned on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms, client agreements, statements or reports or any other form of correspondence with the client.

added.title: Maintain Call Recording of Client Consents for Implementation/Execution
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must maintain call recordings of every consent obtained from clients for implementation or execution if advice is given through a telephone call.
added.trigger: Providing implementation/execution services to advisory clients in the securities market via telephone calls
added.required_action: Maintain time-stamped call recordings of every consent for implementation or execution obtained from clients through a telephone call.
added.evidence: Call recording logs with timestamps and client consents.
added.verbatim_text: IAs providing implementation/execution services shall maintain call recording of every consent for implementation/execution obtained from the client if advice/execution is given through telephone call. All such communications shall have time stamped to maintain clear audit trail.

added.title: Obtain Annual Certificate of Compliance from ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI or Auditor
added.summary: IAs must obtain an annual certificate confirming compliance with client-level segregation requirements.
added.trigger: End of each financial year
added.required_action: Obtain an annual certificate from a member of ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI or an auditor confirming compliance with client-level segregation requirements within six months of the end of the financial year.
added.evidence: Annual certificate of compliance.
added.verbatim_text: An IA shall - (iii) maintain on record an annual certificate from a member of ICAI/ICSI/ ICMAI or from an auditor confirming compliance with client level segregation requirements. Such annual certificate shall be obtained within six months of the end of the financial year and form part of compliance audit, in terms of Regulation 19(3) of the IA Regulations.

added.title: Provide detailed information for online application
added.summary: IAs must provide specific details as part of the online application.
added.trigger: Change in control of IA
added.required_action: Submit required information and declarations.
added.evidence: Online application with all necessary documents.
added.verbatim_text: IA shall make an online application to IAASB/SEBI for prior approval. The online application shall be accompanied by the following information/ declaration/ undertaking about itself, the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control and the directors/ partners of the acquirer(s)/ the person(s) who shall have the control: a. Current and proposed shareholding pattern of the applicant b. Whether any application was made in the past to SEBI seeking registration in any capacity but was not granted? If yes, details thereof. c. Whether any action has been initiated/ taken under Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 (SCRA)/ Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (SEBI Act) or rules and regulations made thereunder? If yes, the status thereof along with the corrective action taken to avoid such violations in the future. The acquirer/ the person who shall have the control shall also confirm that it shall honour all past liabilities/ obligations of the applicant, if any. d. Whether any investor complaint is pending? If yes, steps taken and confirmation that the acquirer/ the person who shall have the control shall resolve the same. e. Details of litigation(s), if any. f. Confirmation that all the fees due to SEBI/IAASB have been paid. g. Declaration cum undertaking of the applicant and the acquirer/ the person who shall have the control (in the format specified at Annexure G), duly stamped and signed by their authorized signatories that: i. there will not be any change in the Board of Directors of incumbent, till the time prior approval is granted; ii. pursuant to grant of prior approval by SEBI, the incumbent shall inform all the existing investors/ clients about the proposed change prior to effecting the same, in order to enable them to take informed decision regarding their continuance or otherwise with the new management; and iii. the ‘fit and proper person’ criteria as specified in Schedule II of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008 are complied with.

added.title: File application within six months
added.summary: IAs must file an application within six months after obtaining prior approval.
added.trigger: Prior approval granted by SEBI for change in control
added.required_action: File an application within six months from the date of such approval.
added.evidence: Application filed with all necessary documents.
added.verbatim_text: The prior approval granted by SEBI shall be valid for a period of six months from the date of such approval within which the applicant shall file application

added.title: Obtain prior approval for change in control from SEBI
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must obtain prior approval from SEBI before making a proposed change in control.
added.trigger: Proposed change in control of an IA
added.required_action: File application with SEBI for approval
added.evidence: Application filed with SEBI and receipt acknowledgment
added.verbatim_text: The application seeking approval for the proposed change in control of the IA shall be filed with SEBI prior to filing the application with NCLT.

added.title: Client Consent for Trades
added.summary: IA cannot execute trades on behalf of the client without explicit consent.
added.trigger: Executing trade on behalf of the client
added.required_action: Obtain specific and positive consent from the client for every trade.
added.evidence: Client's signed consent form for each trade.
added.verbatim_text: This agreement is for the investment advisory services provided by the IA and IA cannot execute/carry out any trade (purchase/sell transaction) on behalf of the client without his/her/its specific and positive consent on every trade. Thus, the client is advised not to permit IA to execute any trade on his/her/its behalf without explicit consent.

added.title: Client Contact Details Update
added.summary: IAs must ensure clients keep their contact details updated.
added.trigger: At any time, but especially when services are renewed or changed
added.required_action: Ensure client contact details are up to date
added.evidence: Client records showing updated contact information
added.verbatim_text: Clients are required to keep contact details, including email id and mobile number/s updated with the IA at all times.

added.title: Prioritize Client Interest
added.summary: Intermediaries must prioritize client interest over personal interest in all advice, investment decisions, and transactions.
added.trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
added.required_action: Ensure that personal interest does not conflict with client’s interest in all advice, investment decisions, and transactions.
added.evidence: Client records, transaction logs.
added.verbatim_text: Intermediaries and their associated persons shall, iv. ensure that their personal interest does, at any time conflict with their duty to their clients and client’s interest always takes primacy in their advice, investment decisions and transactions;

added.title: Redress client complaints via designated email ID
added.summary: Resolve client complaints through the IAASB's designated email.
added.trigger: Complaint Redressal Mechanism
added.required_action: Respond to complaints received via email.
added.evidence: Records of emails or communication logs.
added.verbatim_text: i. SCORES 2.0 (a web based centralized grievance redressal system of SEBI for facilitating effective grievance redressal in time-bound manner) (https://scores.sebi.gov.in)

added.title: Redress client complaints through IAASB first review
added.summary: Initiate the first level of complaint redressal with IAASB.
added.trigger: Complaint Redressal Mechanism
added.required_action: Submit complaints to IAASB for initial review.
added.evidence: Records of complaints submitted to IAASB or communication logs.
added.verbatim_text: i. SCORES 2.0 (a web based centralized grievance redressal system of SEBI for facilitating effective grievance redressal in time-bound manner) (https://scores.sebi.gov.in)

added.title: Redress client complaints via physical address
added.summary: Provide a physical address where clients can send their complaints.
added.trigger: Complaint Redressal Mechanism
added.required_action: Maintain and provide the physical address for complaint submission.
added.evidence: Records of complaints received or communication logs.
added.verbatim_text: With regard to physical complaints, investors may send their complaints to Office of Investor Assistance and Education, Securities and Exchange Board of India, SEBI Bhavan, Plot No. C4-A, ‘G’ Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai - 400 051

added.title: Redress client complaints through SEBI second review
added.summary: Initiate the second level of complaint redressal with SEBI.
added.trigger: Complaint Redressal Mechanism
added.required_action: Submit complaints to SEBI for final review.
added.evidence: Records of complaints submitted to SEBI or communication logs.
added.verbatim_text: i. SCORES 2.0 (a web based centralized grievance redressal system of SEBI for facilitating effective grievance redressal in time-bound manner) (https://scores.sebi.gov.in)

added.title: Redress client complaints through SMARTODR platform
added.summary: Resolve client complaints via the SMARTODR online conciliation or arbitration platform.
added.trigger: Complaint Redressal Mechanism
added.required_action: Use SMARTODR for complaint resolution through online methods.
added.evidence: Records of complaints filed or resolved via SMARTODR.
added.verbatim_text: If the Investor is not satisfied with the resolution provided by the Market Participants, then the Investor has the option to file the complaint/ grievance on SMARTODR platform for its resolution through online conciliation or arbitration.

added.title: Appoint Independent Professional as Compliance Officer
added.summary: A non-individual investment adviser may appoint an independent professional who is a member of ICAI, ICSI, ICMAI or another specified body and holds relevant NISM certifications.
added.trigger: Non-individual IA needs to ensure compliance with SEBI regulations.
added.required_action: Appoint an independent professional as the compliance officer who meets the specified criteria.
added.evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with details of appointed compliance officer and undertaking from principal officer.
added.verbatim_text: In terms of Regulation 20 of the IA Regulations, a non-individual investment adviser may appoint an independent professional who is a member of ICAI or ICSI or ICMAI or member of any other professional body as may be specified by the SEBI, provided such a professional holds a relevant certification from NISM, as may be specified by the SEBI.

added.title: Submit Undertaking for Monitoring Compliance
added.summary: The principal officer of an IA must submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI regarding compliance monitoring.
added.trigger: Non-individual IA appoints a compliance officer.
added.required_action: Submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI that the principal officer will be responsible for monitoring compliance.
added.evidence: Undertaking document submitted to SEBI.
added.verbatim_text: In such cases, the principal officer shall submit an undertaking to IAASB/SEBI to the effect that principal officer shall be responsible for monitoring the compliance in respect of the requirements of the Act, regulations, notifications, guidelines, instructions issued by SEBI/IAASB.

added.title: Certifications Required for Compliance Officer
added.summary: A compliance officer appointed by an IA must hold specific NISM certifications.
added.trigger: Non-individual IA appoints a compliance officer.
added.required_action: Ensure the compliance officer holds the required NISM certifications.
added.evidence: Certification documents of appointed compliance officer.
added.verbatim_text: A non-individual IA may appoint such an independent professional as compliance officer who holds certifications from NISM by passing the following certification examinations- • NISM-Series-X-A: Investment Adviser (Level 1) Certification Examination, • NISM-Series-X-B: Investment Adviser (Level 2) Certification Examination, • NISM-Series-X-C: Investment Adviser Certification (Renewal) Examination, and • NISM-Series-III A: Securities Intermediaries Compliance (Non-Fund) Certification Examination

added.title: Compliance Officer Liability for Breach of Duty
added.summary: Investment Advisers must hold their Compliance Officers liable if an employee fails to forward market-related news after approval.
added.trigger: Employee failing to forward approved market related news
added.required_action: Hold Compliance Officer liable for breach of duty.
added.evidence: Compliance records and logs of forwarded news.
added.verbatim_text: If an employee fails to do so, he/she shall be deemed to have violated the various provisions contained in SEBI Act/Rules/Regulations etc. and shall be liable for action. The Compliance Officer shall also be held liable for breach of duty in this regard.

added.title: Submit undertaking on compliance with SEBI circulars
added.summary: Investment Advisers must submit an undertaking regarding the compliance of advisory for Financial Sector Organizations regarding Software as a Service (SaaS) based solutions.
added.trigger: Half-yearly periods
added.required_action: Submit an undertaking to SEBI confirming compliance with the SEBI circulars.
added.evidence: Undertaking submitted to SEBI.
added.verbatim_text: The compliance of the advisory shall be reported by IA to SEBI with an undertaking, “Compliance of the SEBI circular for Advisory for Financial Sector Organizations regarding Software as a Service (SaaS) based solutions has been made.”

added.title: Ensure confidentiality of client information
added.summary: Maintain the confidentiality of client information unless required by law or with specific consent.
added.trigger: General Conduct
added.required_action: Keep client information confidential, except as required by law or with explicit consent.
added.evidence: Confidentiality agreements or records of information sharing.
added.verbatim_text: o To ensure confidentiality of information shared by clients unless such information is required to be provided in furtherance of discharging legal obligations or a client has provided specific consent to share such information.

added.title: Define Conflict of Interest Policies and Procedures
added.summary: Intermediaries must define policies and procedures to identify, avoid or manage actual or potential conflict of interest.
added.trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
added.required_action: Develop and implement policies and internal procedures to identify, avoid or manage actual or potential conflict of interest.
added.evidence: Policies and procedures document, communication records to all concerned.
added.verbatim_text: Intermediaries and their associated persons shall, i. lay down, with active involvement of senior management, policies and internal procedures to identify and avoid or to deal or manage actual or potential conflict of interest, develop an internal code of conduct governing operations and formulate standards of appropriate conduct in the performance of their activities, and ensure to communicate such policies, procedures and code to all concerned;

added.title: Identify and disclose chargeable data
added.summary: IAs must appropriately identify and disclose data that is chargeable.
added.trigger: Data provided under regulatory mandates
added.required_action: Appropriately identify and disclose data which is chargeable in the public domain.
added.evidence: Documentation of identification and disclosure procedures for chargeable data.
added.verbatim_text: "Further, apart from the data made available free of cost, data which is chargeable should be appropriately identified as such in public domain."

added.title: Comply with norms for sharing real-time price data
added.summary: IAs must comply with the norms for sharing real-time price data to third parties.
added.trigger: Sharing of real-time price data
added.required_action: Refer to the specified circulars for guidelines on sharing real-time price data.
added.evidence: Documentation of compliance with norms for sharing real-time price data, including adherence to relevant circulars.
added.verbatim_text: IAs are advised to refer to circular no. SEBI/HO/MRD/MRD-PoD-3/P/CIR/2024/56 dated May 24, 2024 on ‘Norms for sharing of real time price data to third parties’ available at: https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/may-2024/norms-for-sharing-of-real-time-price-data-to-third-parties_83572.html

added.title: Maintain Deposit Based on Number of Clients
added.summary: IAs must maintain a deposit based on the number of clients they have.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Maintain a deposit with a scheduled bank as specified by SEBI.
added.evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
added.verbatim_text: As per Regulation 8 of the IA Regulations, an investment adviser shall maintain a deposit of such sum, as specified by SEBI from time to time. The deposit requirements shall be based on the maximum number of clients of IA on any day of the previous financial year, as under:

added.title: Deposit Maintenance with Scheduled Bank and Lien
added.summary: IAs must maintain their deposit with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of IAASB.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Maintain the deposit with a scheduled bank and mark it as lien in favor of IAASB.
added.evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
added.verbatim_text: The deposit shall be maintained with a scheduled bank marked as lien in favor of Investment Adviser Administration and Supervisory body (IAASB), in the manner and form as may be specified by IAASB.

added.title: Review Deposit Requirements Periodically
added.summary: IAs must review their deposit requirements periodically based on changes in the number of clients.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Review and adjust the deposit amount as necessary based on the maximum number of clients on any day in the previous financial year.
added.evidence: Bank statements, records of review, and adjustment documentation.
added.verbatim_text: The deposit amount may be revised for any change in applicable amount of deposit, based on the maximum number of clients on any day in the previous financial year, latest by 30th April of the subsequent financial year.

added.title: Compliance with Deposit Requirement by Existing IAs
added.summary: Existing IAs must comply with the deposit requirement by September 30, 2025.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Comply with the deposit requirement as specified by SEBI.
added.evidence: Bank statements and records of deposit maintenance.
added.verbatim_text: Existing IAs, as on January 8, 2025, shall comply with the deposit requirement by September 30, 2025.

added.title: Develop Disaster Recovery Plans
added.summary: Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure business continuity.
added.trigger: Outsourcing of activities to third parties.
added.required_action: Develop a plan for disaster recovery as part of the contingency plans.
added.evidence: Documentation of the developed disaster recovery plan.
added.verbatim_text: 6. The intermediary and its third parties shall establish and maintain contingency plans, including a plan for disaster recovery and periodic testing of backup facilities.

added.title: Provide prominent disclaimer for part-time IAs
added.summary: Part-time Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide a prominent disclaimer in their communications to investors, stating that the services provided are not under SEBI's purview and no complaints can be raised to SEBI.
added.trigger: When providing other services/raising invoices related to non-SEBI regulated activities
added.required_action: Provide a disclaimer in minimum 10 font size, prominently attracting the attention of investors
added.evidence: Copies of communications containing the disclaimer
added.verbatim_text: Part-time IA shall provide disclaimer prominently (minimum 10 font size) and attracting the attention of the investor while providing their other service/raising invoice related to other business/service that the activity/invoice is related to services not under purview of SEBI and no complaint can be raised to SEBI for the services rendered therein.

added.title: Provide clear guidance and caution for complex high-risk products
added.summary: Offer clear advice and warnings when dealing with complex and high-risk financial products.
added.trigger: Providing Investment Advice
added.required_action: Provide clear guidance and adequate caution notices.
added.evidence: Documentation of provided guidance or records of advice given.
added.verbatim_text: o To provide clear guidance and adequate caution notice to clients when providing investment advice for dealing in complex and high-risk financial products/services.

added.title: Disclosure of material facts to investors
added.summary: Inform investors about key risks, obligations, costs, etc. related to advised products or securities.
added.trigger: Providing Investment Advice
added.required_action: Disclose all relevant material facts.
added.evidence: Disclosure documents or records of disclosure.
added.verbatim_text: o To make adequate disclosure to the investor of all material facts such as risks, obligations, costs, etc. relating to the products or securities advised by the adviser.

added.title: Disclose service timelines and ensure adherence
added.summary: Inform clients about the expected timelines for services and follow them.
added.trigger: General Conduct
added.required_action: Provide clear service timelines and adhere to them.
added.evidence: Service timeline documents or records of adherence.
added.verbatim_text: o To disclose the timelines for the various services provided by the investment adviser to clients and ensure adherence to the said timelines.

added.title: Ensure compliance by existing clients as on January 8, 2025
added.summary: IA must ensure that existing clients comply with the disclosure requirements latest by July 31, 2025.
added.trigger: Existing client relationship as on January 8, 2025
added.required_action: Ensure compliance with the specified requirements
added.evidence: Client signed declaration and undertaking
added.verbatim_text: For existing clients as on January 8, 2025, IAs shall ensure compliance with these requirements latest by July 31, 2025.

added.title: Disclose extent of AI tool usage
added.summary: IA must disclose to clients the extent of use of AI tools in providing investment advice.
added.trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
added.required_action: Provide disclosure regarding AI tool usage
added.evidence: Client agreement and additional disclosures
added.verbatim_text: an investment adviser shall disclose to the client the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing investment advice.

added.title: Provide initial and additional disclosures regarding AI tool usage
added.summary: IA must provide initial disclosure at agreement time and make additional disclosures whenever required.
added.trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
added.required_action: Provide initial and additional disclosures regarding AI tool usage
added.evidence: Client agreement and additional disclosures
added.verbatim_text: Investment Adviser shall provide the disclosure of the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools by them in providing investment advice to their clients at the time of entering into the agreement and make such additional disclosure whenever required.

added.title: Disclosure of use of AI tools in advisory services
added.summary: Inform clients about the extent of using artificial intelligence tools.
added.trigger: Disclosure to Clients
added.required_action: Disclose the use of AI tools in providing investment advice.
added.evidence: AI tool usage reports or records of disclosure.
added.verbatim_text: o To disclose the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing investment advisory services.

added.title: Do Not Fall for Assured Return Promises
added.summary: Investment Advisers must inform clients that they should not fall for promises of assured or exorbitant returns.
added.trigger: Client engagement
added.required_action: Inform clients about the risks associated with falling for assured return promises.
added.evidence: Client acknowledgment documents or records.
added.verbatim_text: Don’t fall for the promise of indicative or exorbitant or assured returns by the Investment Advisers. Don’t let greed overcome rational investment decisions.

added.title: Conduct Due Diligence
added.summary: Investment Advisers shall conduct due diligence in selecting and monitoring third parties.
added.trigger: Outsourcing arrangements
added.required_action: Conduct due diligence
added.evidence: Due diligence reports and records
added.verbatim_text: The intermediary shall conduct appropriate due diligence in selecting the third party and in monitoring of its performance.

added.title: Exercise Due Care, Skill, and Diligence
added.summary: Investment Advisers shall exercise due care, skill, and diligence in selecting third parties.
added.trigger: Outsourcing arrangements
added.required_action: Exercise due care, skill, and diligence
added.evidence: Due diligence reports and records
added.verbatim_text: It is important that the intermediary exercises due care, skill, and diligence in the selection of the third party to ensure that the third party has the ability and capacity to undertake the provision of the service effectively.

added.title: Employ Qualified Employees
added.summary: Investment Advisers must employ only qualified and certified employees.
added.trigger: Hiring process
added.required_action: Ensuring all employees are qualified and certified
added.evidence: Employee qualification records
added.verbatim_text: To employ only qualified and certified employees.

added.title: Ensure Fair Treatment of Clients
added.summary: Intermediaries must ensure fair treatment of clients and not discriminate amongst them.
added.trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
added.required_action: Ensure fair treatment of all clients and avoid discrimination.
added.evidence: Client feedback, internal review reports.
added.verbatim_text: Intermediaries and their associated persons shall, iii. ensure fair treatment of their clients and not discriminate amongst them;

added.title: Charge Fees for a Maximum of One Year in Advance
added.summary: IAs may charge fees in advance, but such advance shall not exceed one year.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(h) of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Charge fees for a maximum period of one year in advance and refund the unexpired portion upon premature termination.
added.evidence: Fee calculation records, client agreements, and refund documentation.
added.verbatim_text: If agreed by the client, IAs may charge fees in advance, however, such advance shall not exceed fees for a period of one year. In the event of pre-mature termination of the IA services in terms of agreement, the client shall be refunded the fees for unexpired period. However, IA may retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee.

added.title: Limit and Mode of Fees for Non-Individual Clients and Accredited Investors
added.summary: Fee-related terms and conditions are governed through bilaterally negotiated contractual terms for non-individual clients and accredited investors.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 2(1)(i) of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Negotiate fee-related terms with non-individual clients and accredited investors through contractual agreements.
added.evidence: Fee calculation records, client agreements, and negotiation documentation.
added.verbatim_text: In case of non-individual clients and accredited investors, fee related terms and conditions shall be governed through bilaterally negotiated contractual terms.

added.title: Fee Limits Exclusion for Non-Individual Clients
added.summary: IA must not apply the fee limits to non-individual clients.
added.trigger: Charging fees from a non-individual client
added.required_action: Do not apply the fee limits to non-individual clients.
added.evidence: Client's identification and classification document.
added.verbatim_text: (v) The fee limits do not apply to a non-individual client / accredited investor.

added.title: Advance Fee Collection
added.summary: IA can charge fees in advance with client consent.
added.trigger: Charging fees in advance
added.required_action: Obtain client's consent for advance fee collection and ensure it does not exceed the stipulated period.
added.evidence: Client's signed agreement for advance fee payment.
added.verbatim_text: IA may charge fees in advance if agreed by the client. Such advance shall not exceed the period stipulated by SEBI; presently it is maximum one year.

added.title: Revised Fixed Fee Mode Limit
added.summary: Investment Advisers can now charge a maximum fee of ₹1,51,000 per annum under the fixed fee mode.
added.trigger: When charging fees from clients.
added.required_action: Ensure that the fee charged does not exceed ₹1,51,000 per annum.
added.evidence: Documentation of fee charges and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
added.verbatim_text: The maximum fee that may be charged by the IA under the fixed fee mode now stands revised and shall not exceed ₹1,51,000 per annum per family of client. The fee limit shall be revised and announced by IAASB once in three years based on the Cost Inflation Index (CII) after due consultation with SEBI.

added.title: Change Fee Mode Flexibility
added.summary: Investment Advisers can now change fee mode for a client at any time without restriction on the minimum period between two changes.
added.trigger: When changing fee modes with clients.
added.required_action: Change fee mode as per revised regulations.
added.evidence: Documentation of fee mode changes and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
added.verbatim_text: In order to provide more flexibility in charging of fees, IAs have now been allowed to change the fee mode for a client at any time, without restriction on the minimum period between two fee mode changes. The maximum fee that can be charged by the IA shall, however, not exceed the higher of fee limit under the fixed fee mode or 2.5 per cent of AUA per annum per family of client.

added.title: Deduct Pre-existing Distribution Arrangements from AUA
added.summary: Investment Advisers must deduct any portion of AUA held under pre-existing distribution arrangements with other entities.
added.trigger: When calculating AUA for fee charging purposes.
added.required_action: Deduct pre-existing distribution arrangements from AUA.
added.evidence: Documentation of AUA calculations and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
added.verbatim_text: Any portion of AUA held by the client under any pre-existing distribution arrangement with any entity shall be deducted from AUA for the purpose of charging fee by the IA.

added.title: Fit and Proper Person Criteria for Incoming Entities/Shareholders
added.summary: IA must ensure that incoming entities/shareholders satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.
added.trigger: Incoming entities/shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative/transmission of shares (immediate relative or not)
added.required_action: Ensure compliance with fit and proper person criteria.
added.evidence: Fit and proper person certificate, relevant documents.
added.verbatim_text: Incoming entities/ shareholders becoming part of controlling interest in the intermediary pursuant to transfer of shares from immediate relative /transmission of shares (immediate relative or not), need to satisfy the fit and proper person criteria stipulated in Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.

added.title: Grievance Resolution Process
added.summary: IAs must have a process for resolving grievances, starting with internal resolution and escalating through SEBI’s SCORES platform and Smart ODR portal if necessary.
added.trigger: When a client has a grievance
added.required_action: Follow the prescribed steps to resolve grievances
added.evidence: Grievance resolution records, communication logs with clients
added.verbatim_text: For any grievances, Step 1: The client should first contact the IA using the details on its website or following contact details: (IA to Provide details as per ‘Grievance Redressal / Escalation Matrix’) Step 2 : If the resolution provided by IA is unsatisfactory, the client can lodge grievances through SEBI’s SCORES platform at www.scores.sebi.gov.in Step 3: If the client remains dissatisfied with the outcome of the SCORES complaint, the client may consider the Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) through the Smart ODR portal at https://smartodr.in

added.title: Provide Guidance on Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide guidance to their clients regarding the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’ (CeFCoM).
added.trigger: When providing investment advice or fee collection mechanisms.
added.required_action: Provide guidance on CeFCoM to clients.
added.evidence: Documentation of communication with clients regarding CeFCoM.
added.verbatim_text: IAs shall also provide guidance to their clients in the agreement on the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’ (CeFCoM).

added.title: Implement Information Barriers
added.summary: Intermediaries must implement information barriers to reduce opportunities for conflict.
added.trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
added.required_action: Implement prescriptive measures such as information barriers to block or hinder the flow of information from one department/unit to another.
added.evidence: Information barrier policies, communication logs.
added.verbatim_text: Intermediaries and their associated persons shall, vii. place appropriate restrictions on transactions in securities while handling a mandate of issuer or client in respect of such security so as to avoid any conflict;

added.title: Scope of Investment Advice
added.summary: Investment advice related to securities under SEBI's purview falls within the IA Regulations, while financial planning services may include non-SEBI products.
added.trigger: IA provides investment or financial planning services.
added.required_action: Ensure that investment advice is related to securities under SEBI's purview and that financial planning includes non-SEBI products where applicable.
added.evidence: Documentation of provided services and their scope.
added.verbatim_text: In terms of scope of the ‘investment advice’ under Regulation 2(1)(l) of the IA Regulations, Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI shall only fall under the purview of IA Regulations. It is however noted that IAs may also provide financial planning services to their clients and comprehensive financial planning may include the investment advice related to products or services not under the purview of SEBI.

added.title: Scope of Investment Advice Under SEBI Regulations
added.summary: Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI falls under the IA Regulations.
added.trigger: When providing investment advice or services.
added.required_action: Ensure that investment advice provided is within the scope of SEBI regulations.
added.evidence: Documentation of investment advice and supporting documents like demat statements, unit statements etc.
added.verbatim_text: In terms of revised scope of the ‘investment advice’ under Regulation 2(1)(l) of the IA Regulations, Investment advice related to securities under purview of SEBI shall only fall under the purview of IA Regulations.

added.title: Limit services to investment advisory related securities
added.summary: The Investment Adviser must ensure that any services provided are limited to investment advisory related to securities.
added.trigger: Client inquires about or is offered non-securities-related services
added.required_action: Limit services to those related to securities and ensure no other products/services are offered.
added.evidence: Signed agreement with clients specifying the scope of investment advisory services provided.
added.verbatim_text: Investment advice, only related to securities shall fall under the purview of SEBI. In case of any services offered by IA related to products/services not under

added.title: Include Liability Statement in Agreement
added.summary: Investment Advisers must include a statement in their agreement that they will not incur any liability for losses due to market fluctuations or underperformance.
added.trigger: Execution of advisory service agreements.
added.required_action: Clearly state the non-incurring of liability by the IA.
added.evidence: Agreement with a clear statement regarding non-liability.
added.verbatim_text: Liability of Investment Adviser: The agreement to clearly state that the Investment Adviser shall not incur any liability by reason of any loss, which a client may suffer by reason of any depletion in the value of the assets under advice, which may result by reason of fluctuation in asset value, or by reason of non-performance or underperformance of the securities/funds or any other market conditions.

added.title: Redress Losses Incurred by Investors
added.summary: Investment Advisers shall be liable for losses incurred by investors due to third party failures and responsible for redressing grievances.
added.trigger: Outsourcing arrangements
added.required_action: Redress losses and grievances
added.evidence: Documentation of loss compensation and grievance resolution processes
added.verbatim_text: Outsourcing arrangements shall not affect the rights of an investor or client against the intermediary in any manner. The intermediary shall be liable to the investors for the loss incurred by them due to the failure of the third party and also be responsible for redressal of the grievances received from investors arising out of activities rendered by the third party.

added.title: No Action in Relation to Securities or Investment Products
added.summary: Investment Advisers must not take any actions related to the securities or investment products advised.
added.trigger: Any action taken by an IA in relation to the securities or investment product advised.
added.required_action: Avoid taking any such actions.
added.evidence: Documentation showing no actions were taken.
added.verbatim_text: No actions in relation to the securities or investment product advised by the investment adviser.

added.title: Not Bound by Contravening Clauses
added.summary: Investment Advisers must inform clients that they are not bound by clauses contravening regulatory provisions.
added.trigger: Client engagement
added.required_action: Inform clients about their non-binding status regarding clauses contravening regulatory provisions.
added.evidence: Client acknowledgment documents or records.
added.verbatim_text: Always be aware that you will not be bound by any clause, prescribed by the investment adviser, which is contravening any regulatory provisions.

added.title: Avoid Disclosing Material Non-Published Information
added.summary: Intermediaries must not disclose material non-published information to others.
added.trigger: On the lines of Principle 8 of IOSCO Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulations
added.required_action: Avoid disclosing material non-published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others.
added.evidence: Transaction records, internal audit reports.
added.verbatim_text: Intermediaries and their associated persons shall, ix. not to communicate the material non published information while dealing in securities on behalf of others;

added.title: Prohibition on Engaging in Prize Distribution Games
added.summary: IA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. involving distribution of prize monies.
added.trigger: No specific trigger mentioned
added.required_action: Do not engage in such activities
added.evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
added.verbatim_text: The IA/RA shall not engage in games, leagues, schemes, competitions etc. which may involve distribution of prize monies, medals, gifts, etc.

added.title: No Request for Login Credentials or OTPs
added.summary: IAs must never ask for clients' login credentials or OTPs related to their trading, demat, and bank accounts.
added.trigger: At any time when a client interacts with the IA
added.required_action: Do not request or share login credentials or OTPs
added.evidence: Client records showing no such requests were made
added.verbatim_text: The IA shall never ask for the client’s login credentials and OTPs for the client’s Trading Account, Demat Account and Bank Account. Never share such information with anyone including IA.

added.title: Prohibition on Encouraging Rumours or Unverified Information
added.summary: Investment Advisers must not encourage or circulate unverified information obtained from clients, industry, trade, or other sources without verification.
added.trigger: Employing workers in offices of market intermediaries
added.required_action: Do not accept or spread unverified information.
added.evidence: Verification logs and records of communication.
added.verbatim_text: Employees etc. employed/working in the Offices of market intermediaries do not encourage or circulate rumours or unverified information obtained from client, industry, any trade or any other sources without verification.

added.title: Prohibition on Using SEBI Logo
added.summary: IA shall not use SEBI logo.
added.trigger: Usage of brand name, trade name, or logo
added.required_action: Do not use SEBI logo
added.evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
added.verbatim_text: The information such as name of the IA as registered with SEBI, its logo, its registration number shall be prominently displayed on portal/web site, if any, notice board, display boards, advertisements, publications, know your client forms and client agreements. SEBI logo shall not be used by IA.

added.title: Notice and Dissemination by IAASB/RAASB
added.summary: IAASB and RAASB must bring the provisions of this circular to notice of IAs and RAs respectively, and disseminate on their website.
added.trigger: N/A
added.required_action: Bring the provisions of this circular to notice of IAs and RAs and disseminate on website.
added.evidence: Notice sent, website update records.
added.verbatim_text: a) bring the provisions of this circular to the notice of the IAs and RAs respectively and also disseminate the same on its website; b) make necessary amendments to the relevant Bye-laws, Guidelines, Standard Operating Procedures, Rules and Regulations for the implementation of the above decision

added.title: Completion of KYC during onboarding
added.summary: Complete the Know Your Customer (KYC) process for clients.
added.trigger: Onboarding of Clients
added.required_action: Complete the KYC process with clients.
added.evidence: KYC documentation or records of completion.
added.verbatim_text: o Completing KYC of clients

added.title: Designate Principal Officer for Partnership Firms
added.summary: A partnership firm registered as an investment adviser must designate one of its partners as the principal officer if no partner meets the minimum qualification and certification requirements.
added.trigger: Partnership firm is registered as an investment adviser, and no partner has the required qualifications.
added.required_action: Designate a partner as the principal officer or apply for registration in the form of a limited liability partnership or body corporate.
added.evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with designation of principal officer or application for registration change.
added.verbatim_text: Regulation 2(1)(s) of IA Regulations provides that in case of non-individual investment adviser being a partnership firm, one of the partners shall be designated as its principal officer. It further provides that in case no partner of the partnership firm registered as an investment adviser has minimum qualification and certification requirements provided under the IA Regulations, it shall apply for registration as an investment adviser in the form of a limited liability partnership or a body corporate within such time as may be specified by the SEBI.

added.title: Apply for Registration Change by September 30, 2025
added.summary: A partnership firm registered as an investment adviser must apply to change its registration form if no partner meets the minimum qualification and certification requirements.
added.trigger: Partnership firm is registered as an investment adviser, and no partner has the required qualifications.
added.required_action: Apply for registration in the form of a limited liability partnership or body corporate by September 30, 2025.
added.evidence: Form submitted to SEBI with application for registration change.
added.verbatim_text: Accordingly, a partnership firm registered as an investment adviser, where no partner of the firm has the minimum qualification and certification requirements provided under the Regulations, shall apply for registration as an investment adviser in the form of a limited liability partnership or a body corporate latest by September 30, 2025.

added.title: Payment Methods for Fees
added.summary: IA must accept fees through specified modes only.
added.trigger: Receiving client's payment for fees
added.required_action: Accept payments via cheque, online bank transfer, UPI, or Centralized Fee Collection Mechanism (CeFCoM). Cash is not allowed.
added.evidence: Payment records and CeFCoM agreement if applicable.
added.verbatim_text: Fees to IA may be paid by the client through any of the specified modes like cheque, online bank transfer, UPI, etc. Cash payment is not allowed. Optionally the client can make payments through Centralized Fee Collection Mechanism (CeFCoM), managed by BSE Limited (i.e. currently recognized IAASB).

added.title: Identify and appoint a person-in-charge in case of death/disability
added.summary: The Investment Adviser must identify and appoint a person-in-charge to take over their responsibilities in the event of their death or disability.
added.trigger: Investment Adviser's death / disability
added.required_action: Identify, appoint, and document the full name, PAN, and contact details of the person-in-charge. Set out steps for taking charge over in case of eventuality.
added.evidence: Signed agreement with the appointed person-in-charge detailing their responsibilities and contact information.
added.verbatim_text: The agreement must set out the full name, PAN and contact details of such Obligor. The agreement must disclose the steps to be taken by the Obligor in the event of the above eventuality in order to ensure protection of interest of the clients and redressal of clients’ claims.

added.title: Comply with Revised Qualification Criteria
added.summary: Individual investment advisers or principal officers of non-individual investment advisers must meet the revised qualification criteria as per current regulation.
added.trigger: As on September 30, 2020
added.required_action: Comply with the revised qualification criteria under Regulation 7 of the IA Regulations effective from December 16, 2024.
added.evidence: Documentation proving compliance with the required qualifications.
added.verbatim_text: "(b) Subsequently, vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2024, experience requirement has been removed and qualification requirement has been relaxed under Regulation 7 of the IA Regulations, effective from December 16, 2024. For Individual investment advisers or principal officer of a non-individual IA as on September 30, 2020, who meet the revised qualification criteria as per current regulation shall not be required to comply with enhanced qualification and experience requirement as mandated vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020."

added.title: Enhanced Qualification and Experience Requirement
added.summary: IAs must meet enhanced qualification and experience requirements as per the SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020.
added.trigger: Provided under Regulation 8 of IA Regulations
added.required_action: Meet the enhanced qualification and experience requirements as specified by SEBI.
added.evidence: Qualification certificates, professional records, and experience documentation.
added.verbatim_text: Vide SEBI (Investment Advisers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020, enhanced qualification and experience requirement were introduced.

added.title: Receive Fees Only Through Banking Channel
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must receive advisory fees only through banking channels to ensure proper audit trail.
added.trigger: N/A
added.required_action: Receive advisory fees only through banking channels.
added.evidence: Bank statements and records of fee transactions.
added.source_clause: 2.3 Receiving fees though banking channel only
added.verbatim_text: It is observed that the IAs are receiving advisory fee in the form of cash deposit in their bank accounts or through payment gateways which does not provide proper audit trail of fees received from the clients. To bring transparency in dealing with the clients, IAs

added.title: Maintain and Update Records
added.summary: Investment Advisers shall maintain records of outsourcing arrangements as and when needed, which may also form part of the corporate governance review.
added.trigger: As and when needed
added.required_action: Maintain and update records regularly
added.evidence: Records maintained by the Investment Adviser
added.verbatim_text: Records shall be maintained and updated as and when needed. Such records may also form part of the corporate governance review by the management of the intermediary.

added.title: Approach appropriate authorities for redressal of doubts/grievances
added.summary: Investment Advisers must approach the appropriate authorities to resolve any doubts or grievances.
added.trigger: Doubts or grievances arise
added.required_action: Approach the appropriate authorities for redressal of your doubts / grievances.
added.evidence: Documentation of communication with relevant authorities.
added.verbatim_text: xi. Approach the appropriate authorities for redressal of your doubts / grievances.

added.title: Refund Policy for Premature Termination
added.summary: IA must refund proportionate fees upon client's premature termination of services.
added.trigger: Premature termination of IA services by the client
added.required_action: Refund proportionate fees for unexpired period, subject to a maximum breakage fee.
added.evidence: Client's signed agreement and refund records.
added.verbatim_text: In case of premature termination of the IA services by the client or the IA, the client shall be entitled to seek refund of proportionate fees only for unexpired period. However, IA is entitled to retain a maximum breakage fee of not greater than one-quarter fee.

added.title: Submit Application and Required Documents
added.summary: An individual IA must submit the application for in-principle registration along with the requisite fee.
added.trigger: Application for in-principle registration as non-individual IA is made
added.required_action: Submit the application and required documents to SEBI.
added.evidence: Submission of FORM-A with all necessary documents and fees.
added.verbatim_text: "(b) Such application for registration shall be made in FORM-A as per the IA Regulations, along with the requisite fee and same shall be assessed in accordance with the provisions of the IA Regulations and amendments thereto as well as circulars issued thereunder."

added.title: Comply with Number of Clients Limit
added.summary: The number of clients for an individual IA must not exceed 300 at any point in time.
added.trigger: Number of client agreements in force exceeds 300 on any day
added.required_action: Ensure the number of clients does not exceed 300.
added.evidence: Records showing the current number of active client agreements.
added.verbatim_text: "(c) The “number of clients” shall mean number of client agreements in force at any point of time i.e. limit of 300 clients not to be exceeded on any day."

added.title: Complete Transition Process within Three Months
added.summary: An individual IA must complete the transition process from individual IA to non-individual IA within three months of applying for in-principle registration.
added.trigger: Application for in-principle registration as non-individual IA is made
added.required_action: Complete the transition process within three months.
added.evidence: Documentation proving completion of the transition process.
added.verbatim_text: "(d) In order to ease the process of transition from individual IA to non-individual IA, an individual IA shall initially be required to apply for grant of in-principle registration as non-individual IA which shall be valid for a period of up to three months within which time, the IA is required to complete the transition process. On completion of transition within the time limit, the IA shall surrender his individual IA registration certificate and will be granted final registration as non-individual IA subject to c"

added.title: Identify ineligible persons for part-time registration
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must identify and exclude individuals who are not eligible for registration as a part-time IA based on the provided examples and illustrations.
added.trigger: When registering or seeking clarification on eligibility
added.required_action: Exclude ineligible persons from registration
added.evidence: Registration records showing exclusions of ineligible individuals

If a person is engaged in a business/activity of providing advice/recommendations on assets such as gold, real estate, cryptocurrency etc., it shall not be considered eligible for registration as part-time IA.

added.title: Provide clarity on eligibility for part-time registration
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must provide additional clarity regarding who is eligible for registration as a part-time IA, including examples and illustrations.
added.trigger: When registering or seeking clarification on eligibility
added.required_action: Provide explanations/illustrations of eligibility criteria

added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must determine whether they are required to register as a part-time IA based on the provided examples and illustrations.

added.evidence: Registration records showing determination of registration requirements

If a CA for the purpose of tax planning/tax filing provides advice/recommendation on securities as an asset class to its client as an incidental advice to its primary activity, it is not required to get registered as a part-time IA. However, if a CA is providing security-specific advice to a specific client, even though as part of tax

added.title: Reporting Suspicious Transactions
added.summary: Investment Advisers must report suspicious transactions or reports to FIU or any other competent authority.
added.trigger: Carrying out activities with third parties
added.required_action: Report suspicious transactions/reports
added.evidence: Reporting records
added.verbatim_text: be responsible for reporting of any suspicious transactions / reports to FIU or any other competent authority in respect of activities carried out by the third parties.

added.title: Ensure security and confidentiality of client data using AI tools
added.summary: IA must be responsible for the security, confidentiality, integrity of client data when using AI tools.
added.trigger: Using AI tools in IA services
added.required_action: Ensure security and confidentiality of client data
added.evidence: Internal policies and procedures documentation
added.verbatim_text: an investment adviser who uses Artificial Intelligence tools, irrespective of the scale and scenario of adoption of such tools, for servicing its clients shall be solely responsible for the security, confidentiality, integrity of the client data, use of any other information or data to arrive at investment advice, investment advice based on output of Artificial Intelligence tools and compliance with any law for the time being in force.

added.title: Right to Exit Service of an Investment Adviser
added.summary: Investment Advisers must inform clients that they have the right to exit their service.
added.trigger: Client engagement
added.required_action: Inform clients about their right to exit the service of an Investment Adviser.
added.evidence: Client acknowledgment documents or records.
added.verbatim_text: Always be aware that you have the right to exit the service of an Investment Adviser

added.title: Right to Provide Feedback
added.summary: Investment Advisers must inform clients that they have the right to provide feedback.
added.trigger: Client engagement
added.required_action: Inform clients about their right to provide feedback.
added.evidence: Client acknowledgment documents or records.
added.verbatim_text: Always be aware that you have the right to provide feedback to the Investment Adviser in respect of services received.

added.title: Investment Advice Purview
added.summary: IA must provide investment advice only related to securities.
added.trigger: Providing investment advisory services
added.required_action: Ensure that all provided advice is related to securities under SEBI's purview.
added.evidence: Documentation of the nature and scope of the investment advice provided.
added.verbatim_text: Investment advice, only related to securities shall fall under the purview of SEBI.

added.title: Advise Direct Plans Only
added.summary: Advisory services should be provided for direct plans only.
added.trigger: Providing investment advisory services.
added.required_action: Advise on direct plans (non-commission based) of products only.
added.evidence: Records of advised products and their nature.
added.verbatim_text: "The IAs shall, wherever available, advise direct plans (non-commission based) of products only."

added.title: Waiver for Institutional Clients and Accredited Investors
added.summary: Exempt institutional clients and accredited investors from segregation requirements with a signed waiver.
added.trigger: Providing investment advisory services to institutional clients or accredited investors.
added.required_action: Provide a standard waiver stating that the client/investor is exempted from the segregation of investment advisory and distribution activities requirements.
added.evidence: Signed waiver agreement.
added.verbatim_text: "The IAs providing investment advisory services exclusively to institutional clients and accredited investors may not be subject to compliance with the requirements of segregation of investment advisory and distribution activities provided that the client/investor signs a standard waiver stating the above."

added.title: Stock Broking Not Considered as Distribution Activity
added.summary: Do not consider stock broking activity as distribution activity for segregation purposes.
added.trigger: Providing investment advisory services.
added.required_action: Do not consider stock broking activity as a part of the distribution activity for the purpose of regulation 22 of IA Regulations.
added.evidence: Records indicating that stock broking is not considered a distribution activity.
added.verbatim_text: "Stock broking activity is not considered as distribution activity for the purpose of regulation 22 of IA Regulations."

added.title: Investment Advisory Agreement with Client
added.summary: Enter into an investment advisory agreement with clients.
added.trigger: Providing investment advisory services to a client.
added.required_action: Enter into an investment advisory agreement with the client, mandatorily covering terms and conditions provided in Annexure A and MITC as standardized by Industry Standard Forum in consultation with IAASB and SEBI.
added.evidence: Signed investment advisory agreement.
added.verbatim_text: "Regulation 19(1)(d) of the IA Regulations provides that IA shall enter into an investment advisory agreement with its clients. The said agreement shall mandatorily cover the terms and conditions provided in Annexure A and Most Important Terms and conditions (MITC), as standardized by Industry Standard Forum in consultation with IAASB and SEBI, provided in Annexure B5."

added.title: Include MITC in Investment Advisory Agreement
added.summary: Include the MITC into the investment advisory agreement.
added.trigger: Entering into an investment advisory agreement with a client.
added.required_action: Incorporate the MITC into the investment advisory agreement and disclose it to the client, taking their consent.
added.evidence: Signed investment advisory agreement including MITC.
added.verbatim_text: "MITC must include the following as terms and conditions:: ‘This agreement is for the investment advisory services provided by the IA and IA cannot execute/ carry out any trade (purchase/ sell transaction) on behalf of the client without his/her specific and positive consent on every trade. Thus, you are advised not to permit IA to execute any trade on your behalf without your explicit consent.’"

added.title: Client Consent for Agreement
added.summary: Obtain client's consent for the investment advisory agreement.
added.trigger: Entering into an investment advisory agreement with a client.
added.required_action: Ensure that the client consents to the terms of the agreement, which can be signed in person or through any legally acceptable mode including DigiLocker enabled Aadhaar based e-signature facility.
added.evidence: Signed consent form for the investment advisory agreement.
added.verbatim_text: "Consent of client to agreement between IA and client may be signed by the client in person or through any other legally acceptable mode including DigiLocker enabled Aadhaar based e-signature facility. IAs shall also provide guidance to their clients in the agreement on the optional ‘Centralised Fee Collection Mechanism for IA and RA’"

added.title: Maintain Arms-Length Relationship Between IA and RA Activities
added.summary: Ensure that investment advisory services and research services are clearly segregated from each other.
added.trigger: Registration as Investment Adviser and Research Analyst
added.required_action: Provide an undertaking stating the arms-length relationship between IA and RA activities.
added.evidence: Undertaking document signed by the IA/RA.
added.verbatim_text: Such IA/RA shall provide an undertaking stating that it shall maintain arms-length relationship between its activity as IA and RA and shall ensure that its investment advisory services and research services are clearly segregated from each other.

added.title: Non-Discriminatory Services
added.summary: Investment Advisers must not discriminate in terms of services provided among clients opting for similar products/services.
added.trigger: Service provision
added.required_action: Providing non-discriminatory services to all clients
added.evidence: Client service records and complaints
added.verbatim_text: Not to discriminate in terms of services provided, among clients opting for same/similar products/services offered by investment adviser.

added.title: Share Financial Information with Client
added.summary: Investment Advisers (IAs) must share the financial information of clients, including income, existing investments, and liabilities.
